1

 W.P (
 Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of In
 praying this Court to issue a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, calling f
 entire records relating to the impugned proce
 Na.Ka.No.2871/A2/2023/U.Pa.a, dated 27.12.2023 issued
 2nd respondent and quash the same as illegal and consequently permit the
 petitioner to run the Petty Shop/Coffee and Tiffan centre mentioned in t
 impugned notice as Udhayakumar Petty Shop situated at 139, Thataneri Mai
 Road, Bharathinagar, Madurai by unsealing the premises. 
 For Petitioner : Ms.S.Meena,
 For Mr.A.L.Kannan.
 For Respondents : Mr.Veerakathiravan,
 Addl. Advocate General,
 Assisted by Mr.K.Balasubramani,
 Spl. Government Pleader for R1 to R3. 
 Mr.A.Albert James,
 Govt. Advocate (Crl. Side) for R4. 
 ORDER Heard the learned counsel for the writ petitioner, the learned Additional Advocate General assisted by the learned Special Government Pleader for the respondents 1 to 3 and the learned Government Advocate (Crl. Side) for the fourth respondent.
2.The petitioner is running a petty shop. It was locked and sealed on 27.12.2023 by the second respondent. The learned Additional Advocate https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis General points out that the petitioner is having a bad track record. The petitioner undertakes to compound the offence. 
The petitioner has to pay the compounding charges to the tune of Rs.5,000/-. The second respondent shall issue proceedings immediately and the petitioner shall also remit the same. I am inclined to show indulgence only for the reason that full three months have elapsed. I hope the petitioner has learnt his lesson. Subject to the petitioner compounding the offence, the lock and seal shall be removed. The entire exercise shall be completed within a period of seven days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. The learned Additional Advocate General also points out that the petitioner is not having any valid FSSAI license. The petitioner is restrained from vending any food items for which the said license is required without first obtaining the same. 
3.With this restraint order against the writ petitioner, this writ petition is allowed. No costs. 
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
